_doc: Drafting profile = every office-specific constant a recipe needs. New office/drawing type: copy this file, change values, pass --profile NAME. Evidence for each value: conventions/section-drawings.md
name: israeli-structural

cut_mark.view_dir: local +y rotated by the insert rotation (rot 270 east, 180 south, 0 north)

beam_section_doc: Constants of recipes/ledge_beam.py (hollow-core beam sections + stirrup detail row + cast L), measured on the user's ground-floor examples and corrected by the user; keys are the constant names in the recipe, any key present here overrides the default. Evidence: conventions/section-drawings.md
examples_box_doc: region (x0, y0, x1, y1) of the user's finished example sheet; note-text styles/heights are copied from the first matching text found there

plan._doc: regexes of the labels on the structural plan: beam b/h in cm, hollow-core slab D=panel+topping ; span_leader_layer = layer of the double arrow drawn beside the slab label = panel span direction

general_sections._doc: General sections the user drew once and wants REUSED (copy_region.py --general N), with the box of their drawing in the user's file and where their marks go.

5.what: wall B=20 H=74 + slab D=25 on one side (copy of ground example 1-1)
5.marks: one pair per elevator shaft / stairwell on the wall bordering a slab, slab on the right (scripts/shaft_walls.py)

6.what: simple cast beam B=20 H=74 (min 40) with slab D=25 on BOTH sides, shown 58.9 each side
6.marks: simple beam with a slab on both sides where no hollow-core section 1-4 applies (UNVERIFIED which beams on other floors)
